user_role_scope.name: user_role_scope
user_role_scope.value:
("user"."role" = 'branch_admin' and "user"."branch_id" is not null and "user"."teacher_id" is null)
       or ("user"."role" = 'super_admin'  and "user"."branch_id" is null     and "user"."teacher_id" is null)
       or ("user"."role" = 'teacher'      and "user"."branch_id" is null     and "user"."teacher_id" is not null)

student_enrollments_closed_has_reason.name: student_enrollments_closed_has_reason
student_enrollments_closed_has_reason.value:
("student_enrollments"."end_date" is null and "student_enrollments"."end_reason" is null)
       or ("student_enrollments"."end_date" is not null and "student_enrollments"."end_reason" is not null)

students_archived_has_reason.name: students_archived_has_reason
students_archived_has_reason.value:
("students"."status" = 'active' and "students"."left_date" is null and "students"."leave_reason" is null)
       or ("students"."status" = 'archived' and "students"."left_date" is not null and "students"."leave_reason" is not null)

class_sessions_cancelled_has_reason.name: class_sessions_cancelled_has_reason
class_sessions_cancelled_has_reason.value:
("class_sessions"."status" = 'completed' and "class_sessions"."cancel_reason" is null)
       or ("class_sessions"."status" = 'cancelled' and "class_sessions"."cancel_reason" is not null)
